title: VectrixDB golden question
description: One line of a golden file: a question, where the answer is, and the answer a person would accept. A row golden_template wrote and nobody has filled in yet has an empty question and a hint.

id.description: The question's name in reports. Numbered by its line when left out.

question.description: What a person would ask. Empty only on a template row, which has a hint.

expected.description: Where the answer is: a document by its id, td/report.pdf, or one page of it, td/report.pdf#page=41, the page's place in the file as its citation gives it.

reference.description: The answer a person would accept, for scoring written answers.

evidence.description: The words on the expected pages that answer the question, exactly as they are there, one quote an item: what the golden writer checked each question against. A run can then ask whether these words came back, not only a piece of the right page. A quote of fewer than three words is not used.

hint.description: Where the answer is, for a person: on a template row, how the document or page starts, for whoever writes the question; on a written draft, the page and the words that answer it, for whoever checks it.

draft.description: True while a person has not checked a row that a model or suggest_expected wrote.
